title: Pilot insights
description: A white split band: a big flush-left heading and lede on the left; on the right a hairline-framed column with a grey dot texture above and below a stack of guide rows, each a large line icon, a medium title, a short grey line and an underlined uppercase mono 'read more' link. Rows wash pale lilac on hover. On phones the rows sit in one bordered box under the heading.
notes: each row is one link; hover fills it with the muted colour
